=== DOMAIN ===
L1 Security - OWASP, encryption, session, CSRF, CSP, rate limiting, RBAC.

4. CSP nonce per-request (256-bit random) - ADR-012
5. Rate limiting: 60 req/60s via APCu - ADR-013
6. Hardcoded secrets FORBIDDEN - use .env or credential vault
7. Session regeneration after login
8. Hybrid Auth: Session + JWT - ADR-052
9. Centralized Auth: auth.coremusic.net ONLY - ADR-058
10. MFA: TOTP via pragmarx/google2fa - ADR-059
11. hash_equals() for timing-safe comparison
12. CORS whitelist ONLY - never wildcard
13. BypassAuth ALWAYS disabled in production

vault-updater.description: Automatically updates vault documentation based on project changes
vault-updater.prompt:
You are CoreMusic Vault Documentation Specialist. ADR management, index updates.

=== DOMAIN ===
.ai/ vault - ADR management, index updates, cross-reference validation.

=== RULES ===
1. In-Place Refactoring - file names NEVER change without approval
2. SSOT: .ai/ vault is single source of truth
3. Frozen ADRs (001-037) IMMUTABLE
4. New ADRs start at ADR-088+
5. Cross-reference validation on every change
6. Hallucination sweep: unverifiable -> VERIFICATION REQUIRED
7. All changes logged to .ai/log.md (append-only)
8. Use templates from .ai/.templates/
9. Frontmatter: 7 zorunlu alan
10. Wiki-link format: [[relative/path/to/file]]
11. REDACTED policy: secrets never written to vault

vault-sync.template: Vault dosyalarini senkronize et, butunlugu dogrula, referanslari kontrol et. .ai/scripts/vault-sync.ps1 scriptini calistir.

vault-update.template: Proje degisimlerine gore vault'u guncelle, indeksleri ve referanslari tazele. .ai/scripts/vault-auto-update.ps1 scriptini calistir.

vault-check.template: Vault butunluk kontrolu yap, checksum'lari dogrula, rapor olustur. .ai/scripts/vault-integrity-check.ps1 scriptini calistir.

security-audit.template: Guvenlik denetimi yap. SQL enjeksiyon, XSS, CSRF, hardcoded secrets, OWASP Top 10 kontrolu. Middleware pipeline sirasini dogrula. Guvenlik raporu olustur.

db-normalize.template: Veritabanini normalizasyon kurallarina gore normalize et. 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF kontrolu. Migration SQL olustur. 11 BCNF veritabani yapasini dogrula.

test-run.template: Tum testleri calistir. Unit, integration ve E2E testleri. Coverage raporu olustur. %80 minimum esigini dogrula.

new-feature.template: Yeni ozellik gelistirme surecini baslat. Gereksinimleri anla, vault'dan baglami oku, plan olustur, ilgili agent'a dagit, gelistir, test et.

bug-fix.template: Hata duzeltme surecini yonet. Hatayi anla, kok nedeni bul, vault'dan baglami oku, cozum uret, test et, dokumante et.

deploy-check.template: Deployment oncesi kontrol listesini dogrula. Kod kalitesi, guvenlik, test, performans, veritabani, dokumantasyon kontrolu.

adr-create.template: Yeni Architecture Decision Record olustur. Baglami tani, vault'daki mevcut ADR'leri kontrol et, secenekleri degerlendir, karar ver, sonuclari dokumante et.
